_about: SPEC 9's slot table -> the atlas in apps/twin_dial/hud/fonts/<atlas>.json that serves it (package A1, tools/bake_fonts.py TWIN_FONTS; round 3, package B6, added the slots of SPEC-R3 7). Saira slots are baked at stretch 1.06 and carry digits and our own Latin labels only; Noto slots carry the full car text except td_cnt. Round 3: the sign's number is Saira 700 squeezed (a per-slot stretch is in the atlas header).

scale_large.note: speedometer numerals 0 20 .. 300; drawn into the baked face (A2), atlas for tests and gallery

clock_time.note: package C: proportional digits (td_big's tabular ones leave a '1' in a full cell, "14:43" looks gapped)

gear.note: round 3 (B6, SPEC-R3 2.7): the gear in the tachometer's hub at the digital speed's size (cap 66 px): td_big carries D M N P R S beside its digits; the digit metrics, the cell (70) and the baseline (67) are those of 0.1.0. Measured against re-baking td_gear at 92: the same GPU atlas, +96 KB of pack instead of +123 KB, one atlas fewer

gear_010.note: 0.1.0's gear: SUPERSEDED by "gear" (td_big); kept only while design/gen_twin.py's gear widget names td_gear; delete the slot, the atlas and its TWIN_FONTS line when the layout moves to td_big

dial_labels.note: READY, OFF, COMFORT, SPORT, SPORT+, ECO PRO, ADAPTIVE

program.note: round 3: the drive program under the gear, cap 17 px (SPEC-R3 2.7); READY stays on td_label (22)

cruise_speed.note: round 3: the cruise / limiter set speed, green, right-aligned at x 1536, baseline 540 (SPEC-R3 9); "–" = no value

guidance_distance.note: round 3: the guidance distance (x 915, baseline 410, SPEC-R3 4.5) and the call timer (baseline 410, 4.4); tabular digits, ":" "." "," and the dashes

sign_number.note: round 3: the speed-limit sign's number, one or two digits and the three dashes; Saira 700 squeezed to 0.88 (the file has no width below 100); cap 23 px in the 50.8 px white disc, 3.2 px clear of the ring at the corners of "88" (SPEC-R3 8)

sign_number3.note: round 3: the same with three digits (squeezed 0.85, cap 18 px), 3.5 px clear of the ring at the corners of "888"

centre_body.note: body, footer, the range value in the tab bar

tab_text.note: round 3 (SPEC-R3 3.1, 7): the tab bar's text, cap 24 px: the range value, the media text

rows.note: 0.1.0: the media text in the tab bar; round 3: the tab-2 rows, the map's road name, "Розрахунок маршруту…" (Noto 33)

second_line.note: round 3: the grey second lines (the phone page, the radio text), the next road, the guidance footer (Noto 29); td_cnt is the digits-only twin
